title: mastra-ai/mastra: a TypeScript framework, with a pause for approval
friendlyTitle: Mastra: a TypeScript kit for agents, with a pause for approval
summary: Mastra gained 31 stars on GitHub's TypeScript trending list today, and now has about 29,700. It is a TypeScript framework for agents and workflows, with model routing, memory, and MCP servers. The core is Apache-2.0. Code under directories named ee/ is under a separate enterprise license.
friendlySummary: Mastra gained 31 stars on GitHub's TypeScript trending list today, and now has about 29,700. It is a TypeScript kit for agents and workflows, with model routing, memory, and MCP servers. The core is under the Apache-2.0 license. Code in folders named ee/ is under a separate enterprise license.
whyItMatters: You can start a project with npm create mastra@latest and suspend an agent or workflow until a person approves the next step. A framework is not a finished assistant, and the enterprise folders are not covered by the Apache grant.
